name: Koinos · APM
description: OpenTelemetry do Koinos (Next.js na Vercel): requisições, Web Vitals, páginas, Server Actions, atualização B3, MongoDB, Redis, APIs externas, cron e plataforma.

pages.name: Visão geral
pages.description: Requisições, tempo de resposta, experiência no navegador e falhas.

rawConfiguration.text:
### Koinos · APM (OpenTelemetry)
- **Requisições**: spans raiz do Next com rota, sem arquivos estáticos, favicon e o envio dos Web Vitals.
- **Páginas** exclui o prefetch RSC (`next.rsc`).
- URLs chegam sem query string; mensagens de erro sem números nem e-mails; queries do MongoDB com `?` no lugar dos valores.
- Use o seletor em **1 dia** ou **7 dias**: o tráfego é de um usuário.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Requisições' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND next.span_type = 'BaseServer.handleRequest' AND http.route IS NOT NULL AND http.route NOT IN ('/api/vitals', '/favicon.ico') COMPARE WITH 1 week ago

SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND next.span_type = 'BaseServer.handleRequest' AND http.route IS NOT NULL AND http.route NOT IN ('/api/vitals', '/favicon.ico') AND next.rsc IS FALSE

SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE http.status_code >= 500) AS '% 5xx' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND next.span_type = 'BaseServer.handleRequest' AND http.route IS NOT NULL AND http.route NOT IN ('/api/vitals', '/favicon.ico')
SELECT filter(percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75), WHERE koinos.vitals.name = 'LCP') AS 'LCP p75 (ms)' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'web-vitals'

SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'req/min' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND next.span_type = 'BaseServer.handleRequest' AND http.route IS NOT NULL AND http.route NOT IN ('/api/vitals', '/favicon.ico') FACET CASES (WHERE next.rsc IS TRUE AS 'Prefetch RSC', WHERE next.rsc IS FALSE AS 'Páginas e API') TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND next.span_type = 'BaseServer.handleRequest' AND http.route IS NOT NULL AND http.route NOT IN ('/api/vitals', '/favicon.ico') AND next.rsc IS FALSE TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) AS 'Requisições', average(duration.ms) AS 'Média (ms)', percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)', percentage(count(*), WHERE http.status_code >= 500) AS '% 5xx' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND next.span_type = 'BaseServer.handleRequest' AND http.route IS NOT NULL AND http.route NOT IN ('/api/vitals', '/favicon.ico') FACET name LIMIT 50

SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND next.span_type = 'BaseServer.handleRequest' AND http.route IS NOT NULL AND http.route NOT IN ('/api/vitals', '/favicon.ico') FACET http.status_code
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE koinos.action.outcome = 'server_error') AS '% com falha' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL
SELECT count(*) AS 'Spans com erro' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR'
SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND next.span_type = 'Middleware.execute' TIMESERIES AUTO

pages.name: Navegador (Web Vitals)
pages.description: O que quem usa o app sente: LCP, INP, CLS, FCP e TTFB medidos no navegador (p75, o padrão do Google).

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75), WHERE koinos.vitals.name = 'LCP') AS 'LCP' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'web-vitals'
SELECT filter(percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75), WHERE koinos.vitals.name = 'INP') AS 'INP' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'web-vitals'
SELECT filter(percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75), WHERE koinos.vitals.name = 'CLS') AS 'CLS' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'web-vitals'
SELECT filter(percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75), WHERE koinos.vitals.name = 'FCP') AS 'FCP' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'web-vitals'
SELECT filter(percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75), WHERE koinos.vitals.name = 'TTFB') AS 'TTFB' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'web-vitals'
SELECT count(*) AS 'Medidas' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'web-vitals'

SELECT filter(percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75), WHERE koinos.vitals.name = 'LCP') AS 'LCP (ms)', filter(percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75), WHERE koinos.vitals.name = 'INP') AS 'INP (ms)', filter(percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75), WHERE koinos.vitals.name = 'CLS') AS 'CLS', filter(percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75), WHERE koinos.vitals.name = 'FCP') AS 'FCP (ms)', filter(percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75), WHERE koinos.vitals.name = 'TTFB') AS 'TTFB (ms)', count(*) AS 'Medidas' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'web-vitals' FACET koinos.vitals.route LIMIT 20

SELECT filter(percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75), WHERE koinos.vitals.name = 'LCP') AS 'LCP', filter(percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75), WHERE koinos.vitals.name = 'INP') AS 'INP' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'web-vitals' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'web-vitals' FACET koinos.vitals.name, koinos.vitals.rating

SELECT count(*) AS 'Medidas ruins', percentile(koinos.vitals.value, 75) AS 'p75' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'web-vitals' AND koinos.vitals.rating = 'poor' FACET koinos.vitals.route, koinos.vitals.name LIMIT 30
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'web-vitals' FACET koinos.vitals.navigation_type

pages.name: Páginas e dados
pages.description: Os carregadores de cada tela (view.*): quanto tempo levam e o tamanho do que montam.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Vezes', average(duration.ms) AS 'Média (ms)', percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)', max(duration.ms) AS 'Máx (ms)' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name LIKE 'view.%' AND koinos.control_flow IS NULL FACET name LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) AS 'Interrompidos' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name LIKE 'view.%' AND koinos.control_flow IS NOT NULL
SELECT count(*) AS 'Com erro' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name LIKE 'view.%' AND koinos.control_flow IS NULL AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR'
SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name LIKE 'view.%' AND koinos.control_flow IS NULL FACET name TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT latest(koinos.view.positions) AS 'Posições', latest(koinos.view.closed) AS 'Encerradas', latest(koinos.view.strategy_rows) AS 'Carteira Alvo', latest(koinos.view.alerts) AS 'Alertas' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name LIKE 'view.%' AND koinos.control_flow IS NULL AND name = 'view.portfolio-snapshot'

SELECT average(koinos.view.stale_quotes) AS 'Vencidas' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name LIKE 'view.%' AND koinos.control_flow IS NULL AND name = 'view.portfolio-snapshot' TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT latest(koinos.view.estimated_months) AS 'Estimados', latest(koinos.view.months) AS 'Meses' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name LIKE 'view.%' AND koinos.control_flow IS NULL AND name = 'view.evolution'

pages.name: Server Actions
pages.description: Cada action do next-safe-action, com o resultado e o erro.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Execuções' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL COMPARE WITH 1 week ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Falhas inesperadas' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL AND koinos.action.error_kind = 'unexpected'
SELECT count(*) AS 'ActionError' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL AND error.type = 'ActionError'
SELECT count(*) AS 'UnauthorizedError' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL AND error.type = 'UnauthorizedError'

SELECT count(*) AS 'Execuções', percentage(count(*), WHERE koinos.action.outcome = 'success') AS '% sucesso', percentage(count(*), WHERE koinos.action.outcome = 'server_error') AS '% falha', percentage(count(*), WHERE koinos.action.outcome = 'validation_error') AS '% validação', average(duration.ms) AS 'Média (ms)', percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL FACET koinos.action.name LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL FACET koinos.action.outcome TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL FACET koinos.action.name TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) AS 'Falhas' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL AND koinos.action.outcome = 'server_error' FACET koinos.action.name, error.type, koinos.action.error_kind LIMIT 50

SELECT koinos.action.name AS 'Action', error.type AS 'Erro', koinos.action.input.ticker AS 'Ticker', koinos.action.input.type AS 'Tipo', koinos.action.input.month AS 'Mês', duration.ms AS 'ms', trace.id FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL AND koinos.action.outcome = 'server_error' LIMIT 50

pages.name: Atualização B3
pages.description: Os três extratos: leitura, plano, comparação e gravação. Só contagens; nada dos extratos.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Prévias' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL AND koinos.action.name = 'previewB3Import'
SELECT count(*) AS 'Importações' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL AND koinos.action.name = 'confirmB3Import' AND koinos.action.outcome = 'success'

SELECT count(*) AS 'Com falha' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL AND koinos.action.name IN ('previewB3Import', 'confirmB3Import') AND koinos.action.outcome = 'server_error'
SELECT count(*) AS 'Ocupada' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name LIKE 'lock %' AND koinos.lock.name = 'import' AND koinos.lock.acquired IS FALSE
SELECT average(duration.ms) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name IN ('b3.read-files', 'b3.load-stored', 'b3.plan', 'b3.diff', 'b3.apply') FACET name

SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND koinos.action.name IS NOT NULL AND koinos.action.name IN ('previewB3Import', 'confirmB3Import') FACET koinos.action.name TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT koinos.b3.entries_added AS 'Lançamentos novos', koinos.b3.entries_replaced AS 'Substituídos', koinos.b3.entries_unchanged AS 'Iguais', koinos.b3.dividends_added AS 'Proventos novos', koinos.b3.dividends_replaced AS 'Proventos substituídos', koinos.b3.forecast_changed AS 'A receber mudou', koinos.b3.changed AS 'Algo novo' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'b3.diff' LIMIT 20

SELECT koinos.b3.tickers AS 'FIIs', koinos.b3.pending AS 'Pendências', koinos.b3.divergences AS 'Divergências', koinos.b3.warnings AS 'Avisos', koinos.b3.ignored AS 'Ignorados' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'b3.plan' LIMIT 20

SELECT koinos.b3.inserts AS 'Lançamentos inseridos', koinos.b3.removes AS 'Removidos', koinos.b3.dividend_inserts AS 'Proventos inseridos', koinos.b3.dividend_removes AS 'Proventos removidos', duration.ms AS 'ms' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'b3.apply' LIMIT 20

pages.name: MongoDB
pages.description: Driver nativo (Better Auth e Mongoose). Queries com '?' no lugar dos valores.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Operações' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND db.system.name = 'mongodb' AND db.operation.name NOT IN ('saslStart', 'saslContinue', 'hello', 'endSessions') COMPARE WITH 1 week ago

SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND db.system.name = 'mongodb' AND db.operation.name NOT IN ('saslStart', 'saslContinue', 'hello', 'endSessions')

SELECT count(*) AS 'Com erro' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND db.system.name = 'mongodb' AND db.operation.name NOT IN ('saslStart', 'saslContinue', 'hello', 'endSessions') AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR'

SELECT count(*) AS 'createIndexes' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND db.system.name = 'mongodb' AND db.operation.name NOT IN ('saslStart', 'saslContinue', 'hello', 'endSessions') AND db.operation.name = 'createIndexes'

SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND db.system.name = 'mongodb' AND db.operation.name NOT IN ('saslStart', 'saslContinue', 'hello', 'endSessions') FACET db.operation.name TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND db.system.name = 'mongodb' AND db.operation.name NOT IN ('saslStart', 'saslContinue', 'hello', 'endSessions') FACET db.collection.name TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) AS 'Operações', average(duration.ms) AS 'Média (ms)', percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)', max(duration.ms) AS 'Máx (ms)' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND db.system.name = 'mongodb' AND db.operation.name NOT IN ('saslStart', 'saslContinue', 'hello', 'endSessions') FACET db.collection.name, db.operation.name LIMIT 50

SELECT max(duration.ms) AS 'Máx (ms)', average(duration.ms) AS 'Média (ms)', count(*) AS 'Vezes' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND db.system.name = 'mongodb' AND db.operation.name NOT IN ('saslStart', 'saslContinue', 'hello', 'endSessions') FACET db.collection.name, db.query.text LIMIT 25

pages.name: Redis, sessão e travas
pages.description: Sessões, rate limit e travas no Redis, a leitura da sessão no Better Auth e os logins.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Comandos' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND db.system.name = 'redis' AND name NOT IN ('connect', 'auth', 'client', 'info')
SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND db.system.name = 'redis' AND name NOT IN ('connect', 'auth', 'client', 'info')
SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND better_auth.operation_id = 'getSession' AND name = 'GET /get-session'
SELECT count(*) AS 'Conexões' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND db.system.name = 'redis' AND name = 'connect'

SELECT count(*) AS 'Comandos', average(duration.ms) AS 'Média (ms)', percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)', filter(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'Erros' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND db.system.name = 'redis' AND name NOT IN ('connect', 'auth', 'client', 'info') FACET name LIMIT 20
SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND db.system.name = 'redis' AND name NOT IN ('connect', 'auth', 'client', 'info') FACET name TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) AS 'Pedidos', filter(count(*), WHERE koinos.lock.acquired IS FALSE) AS 'Ocupada', average(duration.ms) AS 'Tempo com a trava (ms)' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name LIKE 'lock %' FACET koinos.lock.name
SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND better_auth.operation_id = 'getSession' AND name = 'GET /get-session' TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) AS 'Voltas do Google' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND better_auth.operation_id = 'handleOAuthCallback' AND http.response.status_code IS NOT NULL FACET http.response.status_code

pages.name: APIs externas
pages.description: brapi (cotações e catálogo), Yahoo Finance (proventos, histórico e reserva) e Google (login).

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND http.client.name = 'fetch' AND net.peer.name = 'brapi.dev'

SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE (http.status_code >= 400 OR otel.status_code = 'ERROR')) AS '% com falha' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND http.client.name = 'fetch' AND net.peer.name = 'brapi.dev'
SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND http.client.name = 'fetch' AND net.peer.name LIKE '%.yahoo.com'
SELECT latest(koinos.brapi.month_requests) / latest(koinos.brapi.month_quota) * 100 AS '% da cota' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'quotes.brapi' SINCE 1 month ago
SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND http.client.name = 'fetch' FACET net.peer.name TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND http.client.name = 'fetch' FACET net.peer.name TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) AS 'Chamadas', average(duration.ms) AS 'Média (ms)', percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)', percentage(count(*), WHERE (http.status_code >= 400 OR otel.status_code = 'ERROR')) AS '% falha' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND http.client.name = 'fetch' FACET net.peer.name, http.url LIMIT 50
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND http.client.name = 'fetch' FACET net.peer.name, http.status_code
SELECT sum(koinos.quotes.resolved) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name IN ('quotes.brapi', 'quotes.yahoo-fallback') FACET name TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: brapi pulada (cota) e reserva do Yahoo

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE name = 'quotes.brapi' AND koinos.brapi.skipped IS TRUE) AS 'brapi pulada', filter(count(*), WHERE name = 'quotes.yahoo-fallback') AS 'Yahoo cobriu' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name IN ('quotes.brapi', 'quotes.yahoo-fallback')

pages.name: Cron diário
pages.description: /api/cron/daily: cotações, proventos, histórico mensal e catálogo.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT duration.ms AS 'ms', koinos.tickers AS 'Tickers', koinos.quotes.status AS 'Cotações', koinos.dividends.updated AS 'Proventos', koinos.history.months_fetched AS 'Meses de histórico', koinos.catalog.entries AS 'Catálogo', otel.status_code AS 'Status' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'cron.daily' LIMIT 30 SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT average(duration.ms) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name IN ('cron.load-tickers', 'cron.refresh-quotes', 'cron.refresh-dividends', 'cron.ensure-monthly-closes', 'cron.refresh-catalog') FACET name SINCE 7 days ago

widgets.title: Tempo por etapa, dia a dia (ms)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(duration.ms) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name IN ('cron.load-tickers', 'cron.refresh-quotes', 'cron.refresh-dividends', 'cron.ensure-monthly-closes', 'cron.refresh-catalog') FACET name TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT latest(koinos.quotes.updated) AS 'Atualizadas', latest(koinos.quotes.failed) AS 'Sem cotação' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'cron.refresh-quotes' TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Etapas com erro' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name LIKE 'cron.%' AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR' SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) AS '401' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND next.span_type = 'BaseServer.handleRequest' AND http.route IS NOT NULL AND http.route NOT IN ('/api/vitals', '/favicon.ico') AND http.route = '/api/cron/daily' AND http.status_code = 401 SINCE 30 days ago

pages.name: Erros, deploys e plataforma
pages.description: Erros do Next (onRequestError), exceções, comparação entre deploys, partidas a frio e o consumo da New Relic.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Erros', latest(error.type) AS 'Tipo' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'request.error' FACET next.error.route_type, next.error.route_path LIMIT 50
SELECT count(*) AS 'Vezes' FROM SpanEvent WHERE exception.type IS NOT NULL FACET exception.type, exception.message LIMIT 50
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT count(*) AS 'Erros' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR' FACET name, error.type LIMIT 50

SELECT count(*) AS 'Requisições', percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 (ms)', percentage(count(*), WHERE http.status_code >= 500) AS '% 5xx', min(timestamp) AS 'Primeira', max(timestamp) AS 'Última' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND next.span_type = 'BaseServer.handleRequest' AND http.route IS NOT NULL AND http.route NOT IN ('/api/vitals', '/favicon.ico') FACET vcs.ref.head.revision LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND next.span_type = 'BaseServer.handleRequest' AND http.route IS NOT NULL AND http.route NOT IN ('/api/vitals', '/favicon.ico') FACET vercel.region
SELECT count(*) AS 'Instâncias novas', average(duration.ms) AS 'register (ms)' FROM Span WHERE service.name = 'koinos' AND name = 'register instrumentation' TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Dados enviados à New Relic (GB, 30 dias)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(GigabytesIngested) AS 'GB' FROM NrConsumption WHERE productLine = 'DataPlatform' SINCE 30 days ago
SELECT sum(GigabytesIngested) FROM NrConsumption WHERE productLine = 'DataPlatform' FACET usageMetric TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 30 days ago
